subject: king cobra
title: The World's Longest Venomous Snake Mostly Eats Other Snakes

scenes.text: The longest venomous snake on Earth hunts a strange prey: snakes.
A king cobra can reach 18 feet, longer than a car.
Instead of rats or birds, it hunts rat snakes and pythons up to ten feet long.
It also eats venomous snakes, like cobras and kraits.
It swallows them whole, headfirst, inch by inch.
Sometimes it even eats smaller king cobras. It's in the name: king of the snakes.

description:
The king cobra, the longest venomous snake in the world at up to 18 feet, eats mainly other snakes.
Its prey includes rat snakes and pythons up to about ten feet, and even venomous Indian cobras, kraits and smaller king cobras.
Would you rather meet the king cobra or what it eats?
first_comment: Its scientific name, Ophiophagus, means snake eater. Which snake scares you most?
